prompt:
The section sections/contact-details.liquid always prints an email, phone and address list item, even when the merchant left a field blank. Change it so that blank fields are skipped. Keep the {% schema %} block exactly as it is, byte for byte. Inputs. All of them are under section.settings and every key is always supplied: - section.settings.heading: string or null - section.settings.email: string or null - section.settings.phone: string or null - section.settings.address: string or null Required output. It must be a single line with no whitespace between tags:

HEADING

    ITEMS
Heading rules: - HEADING is the heading escaped with the core `escape` filter. It is not stripped. - A null heading produces an empty h2. The h2 and the ul are always output. Item rules: - First strip leading and trailing whitespace from each of email, phone and address. A null value counts as the empty string. - A field is shown only if its stripped value is not empty. - Shown values use the stripped value, HTML-escaped with `escape`. - ITEMS contains, in this order and only for shown fields: 1.
  • EMAIL
    • 2.
  • PHONE
    • 3.
  • ADDRESS
    • - If no field is shown, the ul is empty:
      . - A value such as "0" is non-empty and is shown. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/contact-details.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
